text: At historical entry 2135 and fixed0b93, the comment says Wait one second before showing queued authentication notices, but setTimeout receives10000 milliseconds. The landing fixes a duplicated article in the following line and leaves this duration mismatch. A focused proposed comment correction is to state ten seconds, matching the inspected value. This is not an applied change, a new timeout preference, or a reproduced protocol failure. No timer or server test ran.
title: The NickServ queue comment says one second but the timer receives ten seconds
